node.statement: For each n>=1, the triangle inequality and submultiplicativity applied to child 1.2.1, together with ||Upsilon_n-tilde-Upsilon_n||<=C_Upsilon*eta, ||Delta_n||<=1, ||tilde-Upsilon_n||<=2, and ||Delta_n-tilde-Delta_n||<=C_Delta*eta from child 1.1, give ||(Upsilon Delta-I_B)_n||<=(C_Upsilon+2*C_Delta)*eta.
